title: Agenda Block
description: Numbered agenda items with optional discussion, decision, and sub-items. Use `numberingStyle: "section"` (default) for §-prefixed items (meeting minutes), or `numberingStyle: "decimal"` for plain numbered items (1., 2., …) with optional decimal sub-items (1.1., 1.2., …). Item text passes through inline markup.

numberingStyle.description: Top-level item numbering. `section` renders `§ 1`, `§ 2`, … `decimal` renders `1.`, `2.`, … (and enables `subItems` decimal sub-numbering).

decisionLabel.description: Label for the decision line. Default is Swedish "Beslut:". Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a space — the label is single-line.

title.description: Agenda item title. Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a line break.

discussion.description: Discussion text. Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a line break.

decision.description: Decision text. Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a line break.

subItems.description: Optional flat sub-items rendered with decimal sub-numbering (1.1., 1.2., …). Only meaningful with `numberingStyle: "decimal"`. Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a line break.
